'''Yao Shouzhuo''' ({{zh|c=姚守拙|p=Yáo Shǒuzhuō}}; 6 March 1936 – 27 August 2025) was a Chinese analytical chemist and politician who was a professor at [[Tsinghua University]], [[Hunan University]] and [[Hunan Normal University]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. 

Yao was a delegate to the [[8th National People's Congress]].<ref name="ab">{{cite news |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250906A01WDF00 |script-title=zh:姚守拙同志逝世，中央组织部、中央统战部等发来唁电、唁函或敬送花圈 |work=qq.com |date=2025-09-06 |access-date=2025-09-12 |language=zh}}</ref> He was a member of the 9th National Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]] and a member of the Standing Committee of the 10th Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.<ref name="ab"/> He was vice chairperson of the 8th and 9th [[Hunan Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].<ref name="ab"/> He was a member of the Standing Committee of the 12th and 13th Central Committees of the [[Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party]].<ref name="ab"/>

== Biography ==
Yao was born in [[Songjiang, Shanghai|Songjiang County]] (now Songjiang District), [[Shanghai]], on 6 March 1936.<ref name="ab"/> His grandfather was killed by Japanese soldiers during the [[Second Sino-Japanese War|Japanese invasion of China]]. In 1952, he was accepted to [[Nankai University]], two years later, he was sent to study at [[Saint Petersburg State University|Leningrad State University]] (now Saint Petersburg State University) on government scholarships.<ref name="ab"/>

Yao returned to China in 1959 and became a professor at [[Tsinghua University]].<ref name="ab"/> In 1962, he moved to [[Hunan University]].<ref name="ab"/><ref>{{cite news |author1=Zhong Jinhan ({{lang|zh|钟锦涵}}) |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250831A05UJG00 |script-title=zh:告别！姚守拙院士 |work=qq.com |date=2025-08-31 |access-date=2025-09-12 |language=zh}}</ref> In 1970, he was sentenced for the crime of collaborating with the enemy and betraying the country. During his imprisonment, he completed the development of the "sulfur-absorbing battery", established a laboratory for testing non-ferrous metals and other raw materials at Hunan Motor Factory, and authored a book titled "Practical Rapid Chemical Analysis for Factories". He was rehabilitated in 1979. He joined the [[Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party]] in 1986. In 1997, he was recruited as a professor at [[Hunan Normal University]], serving in the post until his retirement in September 2018.<ref name="ab"/>

On 27 August 2025, Yao died in [[Changsha]], [[Hunan]], at the age of 89.<ref name="ab"/><ref>{{cite news |author1=Jiang Shiyu ({{lang|zh|蒋诗雨}}) |url=https://www.hunantoday.cn/news/xhn/202508/30338577.html |script-title=zh:守拙之光，生生不息——姚守拙院士遗体送别仪式现场侧记 |work=hunantoday.cn |date=2025-08-31 |access-date=2025-09-12 |language=zh}}</ref>
